spell.name: Test Spark
entries: A spark leaps at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Quiet Ward
entries: You touch a door. Sounds can't pass through it for the duration.
